list_child.name: lsCrossings
list_child.desc: This tool returns the full list of crossings tracked across every route the ferry line operates. It includes crossings in every status from scheduled through docked.

get_child.name: getCrossing
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single crossing record using its unique identifier. It returns all fields currently stored for that crossing.

list_parent.name: lsOperators
list_parent.desc: This tool returns the full list of operating companies registered with the ferry line. It includes both current and historical operators.

get_parent.name: getOperator
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves a single operator record using its unique identifier. It returns the complete operator profile.

delete_child.name: rmCrossing
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a crossing record from the schedule. Once removed, the crossing cannot be recovered by any other tool.

set_enum.name: setCrossingStatus
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a crossing's status among scheduled, boarding, underway, and docked. It is the standard way to advance a crossing through its lifecycle.

set_bool.name: flagOverloaded
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a crossing as over its passenger or vehicle capacity. It is used when the loading crew reports the vessel is full beyond its rated limit.

set_ref.name: reassignOperator
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a crossing to a different operating company, for example after a route contract changes hands. The crossing's schedule and history remain attached to the record.

send.name: notifyOperator
send.desc: This tool sends a notification to the company operating a given crossing. It is used to relay schedule changes or capacity concerns.

sort.sup_phrase: the crossing with the earliest departure
sort.ord_phrase: the crossing with the {ord} earliest departure
